textbookBox.concept: Khetaram has been the sole postman of Somarad Branch Post Office in Rajasthan for fifteen years, in the Thar desert only 2.5 km short of the Indo-Pakistan border.

beats.en: Khetaram has been the sole postman of Somarad Branch Post Office in Rajasthan for fifteen years, in the Thar desert only 2.5 km short of the Indo-Pakistan border.
beats.speakEn: Khetaram has been the sole postman of Somarad Branch Post Office in Rajasthan for fifteen years, in the Thar desert only 2.5 km short of the Indo-Pakistan border.

beats.en: His left shoulder is slumped from carrying a mailbag. The regulation limit is 28 kg and the mail must reach the border within 24 hours of dispatch from Jodhpur.

textbookBox.concept: He walks on hot sand where temperatures cross 50 degrees. Sometimes he delivers after sundown, and water is too precious to wash with, so he can only wipe his body.
